visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a steaming ceramic bowl filled with chicken soup, topped with chopped green onions. A metal spoon lifts a large piece of dark-skinned chicken leg, showing its texture and bone. The lighting is bright and warm, highlighting the oil droplets on the soup's surface. (2) Medium shot of a middle-aged man with short dark hair wearing a black face mask, an orange t-shirt, and a dark apron. He is speaking while standing inside a restaurant with a red brick-patterned wall in the background. (3) Extreme close-up of a chef's knife slicing through a piece of cooked, skin-on chicken on a green plastic cutting board. The meat is neatly arranged in thin slices, revealing its moist and tender interior. (4) Wide shot of a large industrial stainless steel pot. Inside, multiple chicken carcasses and black chicken feet are being boiled in a clear broth. The camera pans slightly to show the depth of the pot. (5) A montage of various dishes being served: a bowl of ginger chicken soup with abundant green onions, a bowl of sesame oil soup containing kidneys and testicles, and a bowl of chicken braised pork rice where a ladle pours savory sauce over the top. Each dish is presented in close-up with soft, natural lighting. (6) Visual transitions to the restaurant's interior featuring wooden tables and chairs under warm artificial lighting. The walls are decorated with food posters. The final shot shows the exterior storefront with a large brown sign and motorcycles parked outside.
